These are wonderful and for the price you can't go wrong. I got the for my mom who suffers from gout on the big toe, it has done wonders for her she can actually wear her shoes without being in unbearable pain. They are very light weight and soft. The only downfall is that they take about a month to ship to you.

It looks just as it's pictured, the price is great,and it was delivered in a hurry.  Unfortunately there's an unfriendly chemical in the manufacturing process that's harmful to human skin.

These are made out of a soft silicon material, and help relieve friction, but don't serve to "re-align" a bunion already formed. I tried a few of these for sale on Amazon, and they're essentially all the same. Same material, same configuration. Exactly the same.
They work great. I wear at work and while working out. One just broke when I was taking my socks off after wearing them for about two weeks.
this really lessens the bunion pain from rubbing

I use plain corn starch (or corn flour if you're British).  These are very soft and helpful for cushioning my large bunions and separating my big toe from the next one over. So many things wrong; where to start.  First of all, the image portrays a nice silicon object that fits over your toe and provides both the toe separator AND cushioning for a bunion.  The toe separator piece is HUGE and uncomfortable.  The silicon bit that is SUPPOSED to provide cushioning just flaps around even with socks.  It is very bulky as well.  IF you choose to order one of these, many of these are being sold on Amazon from sellers based in China.  A giveaway is the 2-3 week shipping time

reviews.t: I may try better ones in the future
reviews.x: I gave these two stars only because they are inexpensive and the company replaced my first separator order because they broke apart very quickly. If you are using them during exercise such as running, as I do, they definitely will not last more for than a few wearings. They fit very tightly around the toe and break apart during removal. I may try better ones in the future, but I will have to check them out first to make sure they are sturdier.

reviews.t: So far they're pretty comfortable and seem to be doing the job
reviews.x: I looked at getting the more expensive versions of these, but after reading some reviews that said these are the same as the more expensive versions I got these. I don't have bunions, but I dance on my toes and I want to keep my big toe spread from my other toes. So far they're pretty comfortable and seem to be doing the job. I was prepared to wait a long time for these to arrive, but they arrived faster than anticipated.

I'm so glad I came across this product. I suffer from bunion pain & my big & second toe rubs together,and makes it very painful to wear shoes. Once using the gel bunion and big toe separator, I was pain free. My bunion no longer rubbed against my shoes & my toes weren't cramped. The gel cushions & lubricates the bunion & the toe separator, keeps my toes in a straight position. The price is unbelievable.

reviews.x: Not sure if these will actually work but going to try wearing them only as I sleep or if im not doing a lot of walking after seeing other reviews that they break easily with friction and extensive walking. The plus is they're really soft and squishy and more comfortable than I had thought they would. Am hoping these will help align my big toe and second toe.

These might actually work, but the texture of whatever this product is made out of is so completely terrifying to me that I refuse to use them, or touch them and will probably throw them out.  They feel like what might happen if gelatin and silly putty made a baby.  Eep!  No thank you.  I'll stick with the alignment socks for now.

Feels comfortable and I wear them all day long - no problem. I did not have any pain and main purpose of purchase is to align (straigten up) my big toes. I've been using it for a couple of weeks only, so it is too early to say whether it works or not. I'll update the review in couple of month.

reviews.t: This device is very comfortable to sleep with
reviews.x: I don't wear this with shoes, I only wear it at night to help reposition the big toe.  My bunion is not severe but is bothersome.  This device is very comfortable to sleep with, more so than "Goodnight Bunion."  Don't know how long it will last but for the price, it's unbeatable.

These are immensely helpful in several ways.  I had a toe removed next to my big toe and have to have a spacer to keep my toes in somewhat alliance.  I also have started a "hammertoe" on my other foot and this keeps the toe in place.  I highly recommend the separator.

I wore these for one day (6 hours) and have now lost sensation to my second toe as a result. I actually started to feel pain and took them off immediately. It has been approx 3 weeks since I wore them, I was hoping sensation would come back but it hasn't.

reviews.t: As good as more expensive brands
reviews.x: These were perfect and are exactly like the more expensive brand I tried first. I bought again. Keep in mind, these permanently move your toe back to where it should be, but they can prevent your bunion from getting worse and stop the pain.

reviews.t: Chafing between big toe and adjacent toe causing uncomfortable redness.
reviews.x: Too soon to have any meaningful comments.  However, after a few days wearing these plastic big toe separator spreaders I have suffered from chafing (rubbing) between the big toe and the next toe resulting in redness which is uncomfortable.

reviews.t: Best thing ever to keep my toes straight and got ...
reviews.x: Best thing ever to keep my toes straight and got rid of my bunion with everyday use for 1 month.  Kinda cheap and will break easy.  The same item at Walgreens is stronger but more expensive.  Overall, it works.

These really did help relieve pain in my toes.  I was surprised how much it helped. And they are squishy so you don't notice them so much and they fit in shoes well. They also are holding up really well.

claims.text: Many reviewers find these effective at relieving bunion pain and friction, especially for the price.
Several reviewers report the product breaks or falls apart quickly, particularly with exercise or after a couple of weeks.
Some reviewers say the fit is poor—too tight, too large, or not truly one-size-fits-all.
Multiple reviewers note these are essentially the same as more expensive versions and a good value.
A few reviewers mention long shipping times.
